institution: CSIR-National Institute for Interdisciplinary Science and Technology (NIIST)
problem_solved: Need for accessible functional health drinks with antidiabetic and cardiovascular protection properties.
description: A process for creating functional beverages by microencapsulating tropical fruit juices, such as jamun and pomegranate, with extracts of herbs, spices, and medicinal plants. The formulation is blended in unique proportions to encapsulate active ingredients using stirred tank vessels and spray driers.
applications: • Manufacturing of ready-to-constitute therapeutic health drinks • Production of microencapsulated functional beverage powders • Formulation of specialized clinical nutrition juices • Processing of bioactive-rich plant ingredients for the beverage industry
